Atlas of all 169 R functions

Source: vignettes/articles/function-atlas.Rmd
function-atlas.Rmd

Complete R function atlas

Every public R function in this development branch is documented by its generated .Rd help page. This atlas is a navigation map rather than a second implementation of API documentation. Each link opens the current pkgdown-rendered function reference, including the authoritative arguments, value description and examples drawn from the package source.

Coverage: 169 exported functions in 14 mutually exclusive research families. An automated website build audit compares the reference index against NAMESPACE and verifies that an .Rd manual exists for every export.

Browse the reference index · Workflow atlas · Scientific limitations
